question: The 3rd edition of the SAFF U-18 Women's Football Championship was held in ________ in March 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****2022** **SAFF U-18 Women's Football Championship:**

__
 
• ​The third SAFF U-18 Women's Championship,** an international football competition** for **women's under-18** national teams that is **hosted by SAFF,** was held in 2022.
 
• **India **finished on top of the SAFF U–18 Women's Championship 2022 standings with **nine points** and a **better goal difference than Bangladesh.**
 
• As a result, India took home the **trophy.**
 
• **AIFF** announced that it would be the** tournament's host on December 15, 2021**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****UEFA European Women's Championship:**

 
• The primary competition in **women's association football **between national teams of the **UEFA confederation** is the UEFA European Women's Championship, also known as the **UEFA Women's Euro.** It is held every** four years.**
 
• The **women's version** of the UEFA European Championship is this competition.
 
• In the **1980s**, the name **"European Competition for Representative Women's Teams"** was used for the **first three UEFA competitions.**
